items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Uh, that's where I first met Pichon was in New York, see? So, uh, uh, Fats was having a kind of rough up there, you know? I mean, jobs were scarce and all that. So he said, man, he said, he was telling Harold, you know, he introduced me and all that. ... Uh, he was working with another trumpet playe

ctx.x: More than Bourbon, what? Anything along Bourbon Street that was-

At that time, I don't remember. But I mean I remember that they had the district out there, because I mean I used to walk around there, you know, like a lot of those young boys used to just walk through there. But as far as Bourbon Street, I don't- I don't remember Bourbon Street well at all. I mean until later on, you know. Yeah. See? So, uh, let's see, now I played around- around the- then, uh, at that time the Cal- uh, the- where the Caledonia is now, there used to be Japanese tea garden. Yeah. Well, I used to…
Maybe, yeah, if you want to. What kind you want?
